title: Due to improper RFC protocol validation in the SAP Kernel used by the Application Server ABAP of SAP NetWeaver and…
description: An improper RFC protocol validation vulnerability exists in the SAP Kernel used by the Application Server ABAP of SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by sending a crafted RFC request that triggers logical errors in memory management, resulting in memory corruption. This vulnerability can lead to a high impact on confidentiality and integrity, with a low impact on availability.
